channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: I started a business with AI and no tech background. Here's what it still can't replace.
item.description: Tim Desoto built a shopping startup using AI, despite no tech background. He shares where AI helped him — and where human perspective still matters.

item.title: Shield AI says its Hivemind AI pilot just flew a drone vying to become a future Air Force uncrewed wingman
item.description: Hivemind, an AI pilot, conducted a flight test aboard Anduril's Fury, a competitor in the Air Force's Collaborative Combat Aircraft program.

item.title: Trump wants Big Tech to build its own power plants. That's already starting to happen.
item.description: President Donald Trump urged tech giants to create their own power sources for data centers. Big Tech is already shifting to private energy solutions.

item.title: 5 biggest takeaways from Nvidia's Q4 earnings — from the new Vera Rubin chips to addressing an emerging risk
item.description: Nvidia posted blowout earnings as it shipped out its first samples of Vera Rubin chips and addressed risks associated with the data center buildout.

item.title: I'm a 2-time Olympic freeski medalist. I don't drink coffee or scroll between runs.
item.description: Olympic freeskier Alex Hall doesn't pay for an international phone plan when he travels abroad, so he doesn't get distracted — he says he likes it that way.

item.title: Hilary Duff says she divorced when her son was 2 to show him you have to 'fight for your happiness'
item.description: "It's a constant conversation to choose yourself and choose something you know that you enjoy outside of family life and kids," Hilary Duff said.

item.title: America, China sees your Chinamaxxing. It's drawing laughs, national pride, and some eye rolls.
item.description: Americans are "Chinamaxxing" on TikTok. On China's internet, the reaction ranges from amused pride to cringe.

item.title: Ukraine says its homegrown Flamingo missiles flew nearly 900 miles to strike an Iskander factory deep inside Russia
item.description: The launch from last week came amid one of Ukraine's largest long-range attacks into Russia, with Moscow saying it shot down 77 Ukrainian drones.

item.title: After 2 layoffs and a breakup in New York, I booked a one-way flight to Asia. Travel changed how I define success.
item.description: Macie Strum felt relief the second time she got laid off. She subletted her apartment and planned what she thought would be an 8-month trip abroad.

item.title: Nvidia rolls back 2 hot-button topics in a slimmer — and more China-focused — annual report
item.description: The report highlighted US chip export rules hindering Nvidia's competitiveness in China's market.
